title: Design Twitter

approaches.name: Timestamped tweets with a merge heap
approaches.time: O(F + 10 log F) per feed, O(1) per post

constraints: User ids and tweet ids are positive integers up to 10,000.
A feed shows at most ten tweets.
Newest-first ordering is determined by when tweets were posted.
Following and unfollowing the same user repeatedly must behave predictably.
